item.title: About me
item.description:
Hey, Vaibhav here!

I love software development!

I mostly work with backend technologies. I have spent about 3 years developing / debugging / maintaining micro-services in Ruby on Rails and Golang.

I also dabble with cloud technologies and handle deployments. I have about a year of experience in Helm charts, docker, kubernetes, AWS services and more.

My other tech interests:

  • Worked with Android and Flutter in the past to develop two apps
  • Explore stuff like NixOS, linux, neovim

Outside of tech:

item.title: Declarative setups with NixOS
item.description:
But… Why?

Over the past 5 years I have had my fair share of changing laptops, setting up windows, sideloading Ubuntu, PopOS and more. Naturally, the process is hard, effortful and forgetful! So I was looking for a more declarative way of setting up things and that’s how I stumbled upon NixOS.

How did I go about it?

The first encounter with NixOS… the configuration… the Nix language… the extensive documentation… I noped the F out of it!
